subject: Discovery follow-up: prioritization check + vendor setup path
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@stormfin.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Redwood discovery — next steps & procurement path

Hi Samantha — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Goals we heard: reduce inference cost for batch jobs (target 40% reduction), keep 99th-pct latency under 250ms for interactive flows, and have private deployment option for regulated data.
- Suggested path: hosted API for initial rollout → Dedicated pool for predictable throughput → Private (VPC) for regulated workloads after pilot.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm procurement contact who will own vendor setup (portal invite + W-9/ACH). If you want, loop them in and I can intro our onboarding ops.
2) I've attached the tailored quote (redwood-quote-DEAL-8341.pdf) and a one-page rollout plan. Let me know if budget timing has shifted.
3) If procurement wants, Connor (cc'd) can run a quick 15-min walkthrough of the vendor portal this week to speed the portal invite.

If I don't hear back, we'll do a quick follow-up mid-week. Thanks again for the time — excited to get StormFin moving.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-quote-DEAL-8341.pdf (pdf, 3 pages)

Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood discovery — next steps & procurement path

Hi Samantha — just bumping this in case it dropped into your queue. Two quick Qs:

1) Has the procurement owner been confirmed?
2) Is the expected procurement timing still the end of July?

If either changed, no problem — a 10–15 min sync is usually enough for us to either speed things up or stretch the timeline. Connor can run the portal walkthrough.

Thanks,
Karthik

Thanks Karthik — apologies for the slow response. Procurement handed this off to our vendor-ops team (cc'd). A few updates from our side: 

- Vendor portal invite: pending — vendor-ops says they need the vendor legal name + EIN; I can push this through but wanted to confirm the exact name we should use on the portal (legal vs trade).
- W-9: attaching our completed W-9 for your records (stormfin-w9-20270628.pdf).
- ACH/invoice: vendor-ops asked for remittance details and the initial invoice; can you share an invoice or a DocuSign engagement letter we can route to AP?

We still view this as a high-priority pilot but procurement timeline is tight this quarter. If you can get the invoice/DocuSign and confirm legal name/EIN today, we can try to get the portal invite out this week.

Samantha Lee
